caption:
The video captures a wide, overcast landscape of rolling green hills under heavy low fog that slowly shifts across the slope and sky. A pale gravel path forks toward the left, a darker paved trail curves through the middle ground, and white canopy tents with a small red frame structure sit on the right. A large metallic ring sculpture stands in the lower-right foreground. The camera remains largely fixed while the fog subtly changes in brightness and density.
A person in dark clothing on a bicycle briefly appears on the left gravel path before the scene empties again. Later, pedestrians carrying backpacks enter near the bottom edge, moving across the lower portion of the frame at varying horizontal positions along the path, sometimes near the foreground ring, then leaving the view. Throughout these crossings the path layout and structures remain the same.
The foreground ring, the white tents, the red structure, and the curving trails keep their positions, consistent with a largely fixed shot as the fog continues to cover the hills.
